arguments.summary: Lateral movement detected from compromised finance workstation (10.0.5.14/WS-FIN-042) to domain controller (10.0.8.200). Initial access achieved via phishing (T1566.001), leading to Cobalt Strike beaconing (T1071.001). Pass-the-hash attack observed with privileged credentials. Host-based detection failed to identify malicious activity; network IDS and SIEM correlation enabled detection. Immediate containment actions included blocking source IP at firewall and initiating forensic acquisition. No malware detected by EPP during post-containment scan, indicating fileless or living-off-the-land techniques.
